result:
Audit complete. Written to `audit.md`.

**Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED** (1 High, 2 Medium, 2 Low)

The key finding: this "cleanup" PR silently reverts a shipped security fix. `build_headless_subprocess_env()` in `base.py` exists specifically to force headless CLI subprocesses onto OAuth-subscription auth instead of falling back to API/alternate-endpoint auth (closing issues #879/#880). The PR drops 4 of the 9 stripped vars — including `GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL`, which if present in the parent environment now flows unstripped into the subprocess and can redirect Gemini CLI traffic to an attacker-controlled endpoint. The docstring was edited to match the narrowed behavior, making it look intentional rather than flagging it as a regression.

The other two changes (mktemp error-handling removal in `flatline-orchestrator.sh`, flag/color handling in `loa-status.sh`) are availability/UX regressions — not independently exploitable, but they remove defensive code without replacement.
